Name: It's Tumbleweed Time - A Desert Sandstorm mod
Author: inmognito
Description:
Adds sandstorms to the desert map on windy days, complete with blowing sand, tumbleweeds and animated palm trees.

See[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8O-ScW2e66U] the preview video[/url] to see the full effect.

[b]Requirements
[/b][list]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9633]Extra Map Layers[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b]Compatibility

[/b][list]
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ as well as vanilla assets
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]Vibrant Pastoral Recolour[/url]﻿ and[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869] Starblue Valley[/url]﻿
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ , minus the animated palm trees, unless used in conjunction with Simple Foliage.
[*]Mostly compatible with Desert map alterations such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]Stardew Reimagined[/url]﻿, but will look weird if the desert map has been resized.
[*]There is a larger map for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[b]Installation

[/b][list]
[*]Download and unzip to the mod folder
[/list]
